title: Gharibabadi: We Are Not Waiting for the US Election Results
text:
Gharibabadi: We Are Not Waiting for the US Election Results"

"Kazem Gharibabadi, Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs:"

"We do not tie our foreign policy to elections in other countries."

"The US election is a matter for that country. What matters is that Iran is neither waiting for the US election nor aligning its policies with it.
